Moderate drinking does not stop most common antibiotics from working, but it can worsen side effects, cause dehydration, and slow your recovery from an infection.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF1xcgYYhygnGGlCuELDNLIhv9c_7eVHfdf1HdeHXxX9Y2tGMtkzufArVzqDv59VzaXtr12GKAB8An5d2_LwDxDQXBvO_GURLNKGelL3mfZCbQrjq-Gr27bJdpbWOwIA45nXRnhAAYNk2rT59RrZhXDr2umAHCF0jFmt3KC_omsUfWoheAIDXM3vKH0AASji3W0-bHFXlPj_RJ7t4Lhte3O9TrECZu8Ic)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXodH9T6RS5J-l3rMzzXB_-Ksx8GVRn2fwa9AM3SdEhGK5RwCwqrftXwtlpFiuGP_BaaHkqh5rbNQqQ2TtgG19Vrie2iqwEV6BvS8o3W5gNZjTX_G6fwlULYXaXRnFX9Hh_79yWPdDADrVIFlL7Yzb)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXYpJIn6lJVne0TzfUecaYZ_0z5Phe3kHer7alFR94xv8UHO7RstA_m6kcrJgWQfD_ZJCWmrFD81Pgt1Xtd9SQeLm0Vopbr2aNZQDVD0QzfhbUowDVGStq9oyqN42xu5Pa7Ef1uDVNz99UZwS0kh0i9w)

### High-Risk Antibiotics to Avoid with Alcohol

- **Metronidazole (Flagyl) and Tinidazole (Tindamax):** Mixing these with any amount of alcohol can trigger a severe reaction (flushing, nausea, vomiting, headache, and fast heart rate). Avoid alcohol during treatment and for up to **72 hours** after the last dose.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXYpJIn6lJVne0TzfUecaYZ_0z5Phe3kHer7alFR94xv8UHO7RstA_m6kcrJgWQfD_ZJCWmrFD81Pgt1Xtd9SQeLm0Vopbr2aNZQDVD0QzfhbUowDVGStq9oyqN42xu5Pa7Ef1uDVNz99UZwS0kh0i9w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF1xcgYYhygnGGlCuELDNLIhv9c_7eVHfdf1HdeHXxX9Y2tGMtkzufArVzqDv59VzaXtr12GKAB8An5d2_LwDxDQXBvO_GURLNKGelL3mfZCbQrjq-Gr27bJdpbWOwIA45nXRnhAAYNk2rT59RrZhXDr2umAHCF0jFmt3KC_omsUfWoheAIDXM3vKH0AASji3W0-bHFXlPj_RJ7t4Lhte3O9TrECZu8Ic)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXNpgcMPSOzkNt5fsmRPAWJcC5aSsh0PTbIDiHrCT3_ii2S_ygMQEBKzQaOlXDUybzJWLFt0Qbbo_2BUljy_GPrbwj8NNjYVqNezjx1WsA8AmFI8CWd-ynEUUhu1xTDqiiVk9FXoopYq3cHNzJkN-lFYu17jxfULkJ)
- **Linezolid (Zyvox):** Tyramine-rich drinks—such as tap or home-brewed beer, red wine, and vermouth—can cause a dangerous spike in blood pressure.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF1xcgYYhygnGGlCuELDNLIhv9c_7eVHfdf1HdeHXxX9Y2tGMtkzufArVzqDv59VzaXtr12GKAB8An5d2_LwDxDQXBvO_GURLNKGelL3mfZCbQrjq-Gr27bJdpbWOwIA45nXRnhAAYNk2rT59RrZhXDr2umAHCF0jFmt3KC_omsUfWoheAIDXM3vKH0AASji3W0-bHFXlPj_RJ7t4Lhte3O9TrECZu8Ic)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXYpJIn6lJVne0TzfUecaYZ_0z5Phe3kHer7alFR94xv8UHO7RstA_m6kcrJgWQfD_ZJCWmrFD81Pgt1Xtd9SQeLm0Vopbr2aNZQDVD0QzfhbUowDVGStq9oyqN42xu5Pa7Ef1uDVNz99UZwS0kh0i9w)
- **Cefotetan and certain cephalosporins:** May cause a disulfiram-like reaction with symptoms like flushing, nausea, and vomiting.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXNpgcMPSOzkNt5fsmRPAWJcC5aSsh0PTbIDiHrCT3_ii2S_ygMQEBKzQaOlXDUybzJWLFt0Qbbo_2BUljy_GPrbwj8NNjYVqNezjx1WsA8AmFI8CWd-ynEUUhu1xTDqiiVk9FXoopYq3cHNzJkN-lFYu17jxfULkJ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXYpJIn6lJVne0TzfUecaYZ_0z5Phe3kHer7alFR94xv8UHO7RstA_m6kcrJgWQfD_ZJCWmrFD81Pgt1Xtd9SQeLm0Vopbr2aNZQDVD0QzfhbUowDVGStq9oyqN42xu5Pa7Ef1uDVNz99UZwS0kh0i9w)
- **Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole (Bactrim, Septra):** Can cause uncomfortable reactions or flushing; check with a doctor or pharmacist before drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXZ2Ea4riuUzD8gLz3-cGKb1-qLx_P3mgGMPPlLNFB8J_88uLv2bg08ktetRV6EMIXygnph71_wmVtL5o8eDfo6yyRcGh1MJpcVG0nhrlGKj0fIDOgUJGc2aGvq5kh0aGwS7js-09-2g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF1xcgYYhygnGGlCuELDNLIhv9c_7eVHfdf1HdeHXxX9Y2tGMtkzufArVzqDv59VzaXtr12GKAB8An5d2_LwDxDQXBvO_GURLNKGelL3mfZCbQrjq-Gr27bJdpbWOwIA45nXRnhAAYNk2rT59RrZhXDr2umAHCF0jFmt3KC_omsUfWoheAIDXM3vKH0AASji3W0-bHFXlPj_RJ7t4Lhte3O9TrECZu8Ic)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF13zRcdCIRx-YOz0qamJp7liFobmHhZRbZcxOWyEgnBbKfSpNGiwVA88qWxsLPjtF7KtEorzlqQcqMPTXOGG_ajI9_Y_iBQdTPs1qYZ2-91ipW_YZPY9mbET2LKuyQ1n4ZSa7zMDsLJPpO4-nnMhj6Ii_aKjatN25VFMF60931wGBk9dwf1__rCt749dZOmfX0Luz)
- **Isoniazid:** Avoid alcohol due to an increased risk of liver damage.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXodH9T6RS5J-l3rMzzXB_-Ksx8GVRn2fwa9AM3SdEhGK5RwCwqrftXwtlpFiuGP_BaaHkqh5rbNQqQ2TtgG19Vrie2iqwEV6BvS8o3W5gNZjTX_G6fwlULYXaXRnFX9Hh_79yWPdDADrVIFlL7Yzb)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXZ2Ea4riuUzD8gLz3-cGKb1-qLx_P3mgGMPPlLNFB8J_88uLv2bg08ktetRV6EMIXygnph71_wmVtL5o8eDfo6yyRcGh1MJpcVG0nhrlGKj0fIDOgUJGc2aGvq5kh0aGwS7js-09-2g)

### General Effects When Recovering

- **Amplified side effects:** Both alcohol and antibiotics can cause stomach upset, nausea, diarrhea, dizziness, and drowsiness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF1xcgYYhygnGGlCuELDNLIhv9c_7eVHfdf1HdeHXxX9Y2tGMtkzufArVzqDv59VzaXtr12GKAB8An5d2_LwDxDQXBvO_GURLNKGelL3mfZCbQrjq-Gr27bJdpbWOwIA45nXRnhAAYNk2rT59RrZhXDr2umAHCF0jFmt3KC_omsUfWoheAIDXM3vKH0AASji3W0-bHFXlPj_RJ7t4Lhte3O9TrECZu8Ic)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXodH9T6RS5J-l3rMzzXB_-Ksx8GVRn2fwa9AM3SdEhGK5RwCwqrftXwtlpFiuGP_BaaHkqh5rbNQqQ2TtgG19Vrie2iqwEV6BvS8o3W5gNZjTX_G6fwlULYXaXRnFX9Hh_79yWPdDADrVIFlL7Yzb)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXNpgcMPSOzkNt5fsmRPAWJcC5aSsh0PTbIDiHrCT3_ii2S_ygMQEBKzQaOlXDUybzJWLFt0Qbbo_2BUljy_GPrbwj8NNjYVqNezjx1WsA8AmFI8CWd-ynEUUhu1xTDqiiVk9FXoopYq3cHNzJkN-lFYu17jxfULkJ)
- **Slower healing:** Alcohol disrupts sleep, lowers energy, and dehydrates you while your body is fighting off an infection.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF1xcgYYhygnGGlCuELDNLIhv9c_7eVHfdf1HdeHXxX9Y2tGMtkzufArVzqDv59VzaXtr12GKAB8An5d2_LwDxDQXBvO_GURLNKGelL3mfZCbQrjq-Gr27bJdpbWOwIA45nXRnhAAYNk2rT59RrZhXDr2umAHCF0jFmt3KC_omsUfWoheAIDXM3vKH0AASji3W0-bHFXlPj_RJ7t4Lhte3O9TrECZu8Ic)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXYpJIn6lJVne0TzfUecaYZ_0z5Phe3kHer7alFR94xv8UHO7RstA_m6kcrJgWQfD_ZJCWmrFD81Pgt1Xtd9SQeLm0Vopbr2aNZQDVD0QzfhbUowDVGStq9oyqN42xu5Pa7Ef1uDVNz99UZwS0kh0i9w)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXToJO_pXoYHTP09uTgbkdDH47ILQj1ziTKX6s8YhRsWsuNhIknaLU01nZDXa2tOKLLwLL8HmCHo9JxdRFnO2uzldMf-3oTd91kOrtgFNqK8xglNq2q5YtYd7-sSo-0DGC8w)
- **Hidden alcohol:** Check labels on cold medicines, cough syrups, and mouthwashes, as they can contain alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF1xcgYYhygnGGlCuELDNLIhv9c_7eVHfdf1HdeHXxX9Y2tGMtkzufArVzqDv59VzaXtr12GKAB8An5d2_LwDxDQXBvO_GURLNKGelL3mfZCbQrjq-Gr27bJdpbWOwIA45nXRnhAAYNk2rT59RrZhXDr2umAHCF0jFmt3KC_omsUfWoheAIDXM3vKH0AASji3W0-bHFXlPj_RJ7t4Lhte3O9TrECZu8Ic)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXodH9T6RS5J-l3rMzzXB_-Ksx8GVRn2fwa9AM3SdEhGK5RwCwqrftXwtlpFiuGP_BaaHkqh5rbNQqQ2TtgG19Vrie2iqwEV6BvS8o3W5gNZjTX_G6fwlULYXaXRnFX9Hh_79yWPdDADrVIFlL7Yzb)

For more details on specific drugs and interactions, see the [Mayo Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF1xcgYYhygnGGlCuELDNLIhv9c_7eVHfdf1HdeHXxX9Y2tGMtkzufArVzqDv59VzaXtr12GKAB8An5d2_LwDxDQXBvO_GURLNKGelL3mfZCbQrjq-Gr27bJdpbWOwIA45nXRnhAAYNk2rT59RrZhXDr2umAHCF0jFmt3KC_omsUfWoheAIDXM3vKH0AASji3W0-bHFXlPj_RJ7t4Lhte3O9TrECZu8Ic) or [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXaLpAmZIP7W73lsUks6Ngi0oOp15JkEV3ute1Qf2jULm9i3k9KdHAMvZQgODlX75jUuk48JMck0vlXJAadEs8W_pWVIpEeK-rjdf0pc0iXYkuA_1E4mC8kZZxZ9hS_FeWBw1j15JPufolZ4c) , or ask a pharmacist before drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXaLpAmZIP7W73lsUks6Ngi0oOp15JkEV3ute1Qf2jULm9i3k9KdHAMvZQgODlX75jUuk48JMck0vlXJAadEs8W_pWVIpEeK-rjdf0pc0iXYkuA_1E4mC8kZZxZ9hS_FeWBw1j15JPufolZ4c)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF1xcgYYhygnGGlCuELDNLIhv9c_7eVHfdf1HdeHXxX9Y2tGMtkzufArVzqDv59VzaXtr12GKAB8An5d2_LwDxDQXBvO_GURLNKGelL3mfZCbQrjq-Gr27bJdpbWOwIA45nXRnhAAYNk2rT59RrZhXDr2umAHCF0jFmt3KC_omsUfWoheAIDXM3vKH0AASji3W0-bHFXlPj_RJ7t4Lhte3O9TrECZu8Ic)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXNpgcMPSOzkNt5fsmRPAWJcC5aSsh0PTbIDiHrCT3_ii2S_ygMQEBKzQaOlXDUybzJWLFt0Qbbo_2BUljy_GPrbwj8NNjYVqNezjx1WsA8AmFI8CWd-ynEUUhu1xTDqiiVk9FXoopYq3cHNzJkN-lFYu17jxfULkJ)If you want more tailored information, share:

Avoid alcohol during treatment and for up to 72 hours after the last dose. Linezolid (Zyvox): Tyramine-rich drinks—such as tap or home-brewed beer, red wine, and vermouth—can cause a dangerous spike in blood pressure. Cefotetan and certain cephalosporins: May cause a disulfiram-like reaction with symptoms like flushing, nausea, and vomiting. Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole (Bactrim, Septra): Can cause uncomfortable reactions or flushing; check with a doctor or pharmacist before drinking. Isoniazid: Avoid alcohol due to an increased risk of liver damage.

items.text: Amplified side effects: Both alcohol and antibiotics can cause stomach upset, nausea, diarrhea, dizziness, and drowsiness. Slower healing: Alcohol disrupts sleep, lowers energy, and dehydrates you while your body is fighting off an infection. Hidden alcohol: Check labels on cold medicines, cough syrups, and mouthwashes, as they can contain alcohol.
